cells.gaps: The WanGov app listed business registration among its services in February 2025, but in 2026 the National Investment Board's online registration system was still being built and, in November 2026, only demonstrated to a minister; no source says it is open to applicants.
cells.note: The newest source, of November 2026, shows the online registration system demonstrated to the communications minister, not opened to applicants, so registration is under way and the stage stays 2.
